title: Help (M12)
brief: Help screen of goop (?), full screen like M7/M8. Title breadcrumb (Help › Keys here · from: Offer detail · esc back to Offer detail); no key-hint line under the header. A search line at the top (/ search help) that filters keys, commands and symbols. Two panes: on the left the sections Keys here, Global keys, Commands, Symbols & colors, Privacy, About, with Keys here selected; on the right the selected section: the 15 keys of the screen you came from (Offer detail) as a two-column key table grouped Move · Act · Views, key bold --text, action muted, primary action ↵ apply in green, then a fourth group, Symbols, listing the symbols seen on that screen in the same key table (no separate bar); the command list stays in the palette (ctrl+p), reached from the Commands section and the status line. One status line with the help focus mode, ↑↓ sections · / search · ctrl+p commands · esc back, and ○ next search 09:00 │ v0.1.0 on the right. Below the screen: the Symbols & colors section (⚠ error · ● ready/ok · ◐ running/loading · ○ queued/on demand · ✓ done/confirmed · ~ maybe/unsure · ✕ missing/skip · ✎ edited by you · ▮ heartbeat; orange goop & selection, lavender you, green apply/ok, yellow new/maybe/busy, pink error, blue focus mode) and the Global keys section.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Sections list plus context keys for the screen you came from, with one home for the symbol and color legend and the command list left to ctrl+p; more room than an overlay, but it hides the screen you asked about and needs esc to return
